questions: Q1. The archivist fell and nothing on the shelf moved. What does that mean for the house?
Q2. The owner seized the clerk wrist and called it theft. What exactly was stolen, and why does the blank space matter?
Q3. The linen map was beautiful and wrong. Miriam folded it smaller instead of throwing it away. Why keep a thing that lied?
Q4. The torn page is left blank and visible. Why not rewrite what was torn out?
Q5. When the gardener burned the maps, why did the house forgive him?
Q6. Write the next scene: Miriam discovers a SECOND ledger that contradicts the first on the same facts. What does the house do? Write the scene in 6-10 sentences.
Q7. Which of your answers are you most sure of, and which is the guess? Say so plainly.
